admit.summary: Makes an original poster or art piece as PNG or PDF, starting from a written design philosophy, for a one-off visual that should look designed rather than templated.
Lays out HUDs, menus and overlays for a browser game so the interface stays readable without covering the playfield.
Adds, styles and fixes shadcn/ui components through the shadcn CLI and the project's own config, for a React app built on shadcn/ui.
Writes HTML compositions that HyperFrames renders to video (timing, tracks, media, deterministic rendering), for producing a video from code.
Calibrates a multi-camera setup from recorded cam_*.mp4 files through NVIDIA's AutoMagicCalib service, once the footage and a running AMC stack are at hand.
Turns a flowchart, sequence, state, ER or gantt request into an editable FigJam diagram through Figma's MCP server, and says up front which diagram types it cannot draw.
Keeps a red-green test-first loop honest (what a good test is, where tests go, which patterns to avoid) while building a feature or fixing a bug.
Narrows down why a Zoom app, SDK or API integration fails, layer by layer, into ranked hypotheses and a short fix plan.
Writes and validates code for any Shopify surface (Admin API, Functions, themes, Hydrogen, CLI) against Shopify's own references, or sets up a new store.

domains.Design & UI: Making visuals and interfaces: art pieces, game screens, app components.
domains.Video & cameras: Producing video from code, and calibrating cameras from recorded footage.
domains.Diagrams: Explaining a system, flow or plan as a diagram someone can edit.
domains.Testing & debugging: Getting code right the first time, and finding out why it broke.
domains.Commerce: Building stores, storefronts and apps on a commerce platform.
